0022600104.text: The Charlotte Hornets host the Miami Heat in the Hornets' third game of the 2026-27 season, with Charlotte at 1-1 (0-1 at home, 1-0 on the road) and on a one-game losing streak, sitting 3rd in the Southeast, 1 game back, and 8th in the East. Miami is 0-1 and 4th in the Southeast, 1.5 games back, and 14th in the East, while Charlotte is missing Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee, surgery). The teams haven't met yet this season, and the 2025-26 season series went to the Heat 3-1, though the Hornets won the most recent meeting 136-106 in Charlotte on March 17, 2026.
